التقطتا (form VIII)
# اِلْتَقَطَتَا (iltaqaṭatā) /il.ta.qa.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# اُلْتُقِطَتَا (ultuqiṭatā) /ul.tu.qi.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
